name: QuickNode
tagline: Multi-chain RPC and marketplace APIs for tokens, NFTs, and on-chain analytics
description: QuickNode provides high-performance multi-chain blockchain RPC endpoints and marketplace add-ons for Ethereum, Solana, and many other networks. Developers use it for wallet/dApp backends, token and NFT metadata, real-time streams, and analytics as an alternative to Alchemy and Infura. Access is via per-endpoint HTTPS URLs and optional authenticated marketplace APIs.

auth.details: Endpoint token embedded in HTTPS RPC URL path (https://{name}.quiknode.pro/{token}/); marketplace/API keys via dashboard for add-on APIs. Self-serve signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan exists with limited RPS/credits; exact free-tier numbers vary by plan — verify on pricing page
pricing.paid_plans: Build, Scale, and Enterprise plans with higher RPS, more chains, and marketplace credits

rate_limits: Plan-based RPS limits; exact numbers depend on subscription tier
use_cases: get latest block number on Ethereum via JSON-RPC
fetch token balances and transfers for a wallet address
query NFT metadata and ownership on supported chains
stream real-time blockchain events via WebSockets
call Solana RPC methods for account and transaction data
